assessment.structure: Three recognizable block permutations, not ten independent narrative structures.
assessment.sentence_variety: Finite engine openings plus optional semicolon join; source clue sentence never changes.
assessment.ordering: Result-first versus context-first is meaningful; known/new order is inert in this fixed result with no prior clue.
assessment.pacing: Lean versus extended blocks and paragraph pauses vary reading pace; long generic attention clauses can drag.
assessment.sensory: Attention to sight, texture or listening is bounded and subjective; no invented physical atmosphere.
assessment.repetition: High recurrence of evidence/examination and the exact source clue; textual uniqueness overstates range.
assessment.readability: Readable throughout, but rhetorical framing and generic joins are recognizably assembled.

verdict: Limited expressive range; insufficient evidence of worthwhile broad narrative improvement.
